snippet.title: SYNTHROME 1.5 MEGA Update Trailer
snippet.description:
We've been working hard to redesign levels, polish the mechanics,  voice acting, cutscenes, lore, and much more, we added in a lot of new features and here we are! We proudly present to you the MEGA Update!

Hope y'all enjoy it!
